title: Longer song, one sentence
prompt: Open the song in ~/music/unidaw-short-sections. Make it a full song: add a Chorus (8 bars) after the Verse with a simple lead melody on the 4OSC synth, then repeat Verse and Chorus once, and end with a 4-bar Outro where only the bass plays.
